items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: and Zuma Cunningham who was responsible for taking Mr. Clark Gable to Hollywood.

ctx.x: Fess is Cab Calloway. So after that where did you go? Now we're up to the 60's. We made a tour, by the way; we forgot to mention that.
When we did the 5 or 6 weeks with the Jackie Gleason show with Joe Bushkin, you, Buck Clayton, and myself, and Zuma Cunningham who was responsible for taking Mr. Clark Gable to Hollywood.
A great lady and a good actress.
